title: helianthemum viscidulum subsp. raynaudii
intro: Helianthemum viscidulum subsp. raynaudii, commonly known as Raynaud's Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the Cistaceae family. It is a shrubby perennial with yellow flowers, native to the mountainous regions of central Asia. The health benefits of Helianthemum viscidulum subsp. raynaudii include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing and exhibiting antimicrobial properties.
